D5/S1/Words/AdmissibleWords/KBonacciSupp.signature: theorem prefix_coupling_supported_coalescence {k n : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (sites : List (Fin n)) (hn : sites.Nodup) (horder : sites.Pairwise (fun i j => i.val < j.val)) (fixed : Finset (Fin n)) (hfree : ∀ i ∈ sites, i ∉ fixed) (hcover : ∀ i : Fin n, i ∉ fixed → i ∈ sites) (x y : Fin n → Bool) (hx : (completions k n fixed x).Nonempty) (hy : (completions k n fixed y).Nonempty) (hfar : ∀ i ∈ sites, ∀ j ∈ fixed, i.val < j.val → x j = y j) : ∀ w : (Fin n → Bool) × (Fin n → Bool), prefixCoupling sites fixed x y hx hy w ≠ 0 → ∀ r q : Fin sites.length, r ≤ q → w.1 (sites.get r) = false → w.2 (sites.get r)
